title: Offering Advice for Improving Behavior and Physical Health for Children Aged 7–9
text_original: vegetables; limit foods high in solid fats, added sugars, or salt, and prepare healthier foods for family meals.  Keep television sets out of your child's bedroom. Limit screen time, including computers and video games, to no more than 1 to 2 hours.  Encourage your child to participate in an hour a day of physical activities that are age appropriate and enjoyable and that offer variety! Just make sure your child is doing three types of activity: aerobic activity like running, muscle strengthening like climbing, and bone strengthening – like jumping rope – at least three days per week.
